Air Conditioner Installation

Air conditioners Installation are one of the most important things that everyone needs in their house these days. They make human life very comfortable. There are many things that you need to take care of when you are buying an air conditioner. When you are spending so much for an air conditioner, then you will have to take a lot of care for it. An air conditioner is not something that you can buy every year or replace it every year. Air Conditioner Installation and maintenance of it has to be handled with a lot of care. Before you go ahead with the AC Installation Service and process, choosing the right model of an air conditioner is very important.

Selecting The Right Air Conditioner For Your House

There are so many things that you need to consider before you go ahead and start your air conditioner shopping. Here are a few things that you need to check before you buy one:

1) Features

Search and Make sure that the Air Conditioner you are looking for has all the features you need.

Don’t go with the basic features of the heating process and the cooling process.

But you also have many other features like the temperature adjustment, timer setting, automatic temperature adjustment and many more.

The price of the air conditioner will definitely depend on the features of the air conditioner.

Most advanced and interesting features the air conditioner has, then high is the price.

2) Size Of The Air Conditioner

The size of the air conditioner is a very important factor that you need to consider before you buy the air conditioner.

If you are buying the wrong size, then you will end up with a big problem.

Don’t choose a smaller size or a bigger one.

You should always measure the right size and then buy it accordingly. Size does not just mean the fitting of the air conditioner.

Fitting is important in case of a window air conditioner only.

The size parameter is important for another thing as well and that is the size of the room.

The air conditioner that you are buying should be able to cool the room that you are installing it in.

When the room size is big, then the number of tons of air conditioner should be high.

Else you will not be able to maintain the temperature of the room as per your choice.

4) Energy Efficiency

The air conditioner that you are choosing should be energy efficient.

Means, it should be given maximum output and at the same time, it should be given the minimum bill.

Many models are available on the market today which will be able to save you a lot of money and at the same time, they are really effective as well.

They may be a little expensive, but you are going to spend just one time, rather than paying high bills every time.

5) Check The Warranty Period

It can be really hard to find that all the air conditioners that are available today are having a good warranty period.

But the minimum warranty that you can expect is one year and sometime you will also be able to get more.

The warranty should be included in all the parts of the air conditioner and hence you need to be very careful and check the details well.

6) Noise Factor

Another important factor that you need to check is the noise factor of the air conditioner.

You will have the window air conditioners usually making noise and the split air conditioners would be making a little noise in rare conditions.

But now you have air conditioners which do not make any noise these days.

So, you can go for that kind of air conditioners.

7) Durability Of The Air Conditioner

The durability of the air conditioner has to be checked before you buy them.

One of the ways you can be sure about the durability of the air conditioner is by choosing the right brand.

Yes, you should always make sure that you are choosing top brands.

Check the reviews and feedbacks about the air conditioners before you buy them.

8) Price Of The Air Conditioner

Last but not the least factor of the air conditioner is the price.

Make sure that you are checking enough brands and models before you decide on which one to buy.

You will be able to get an air conditioner at a better price with the same feature from another brand.

That does not mean that you will have to go for the one which is cheaper.

You will have to check if the other brand is reliable.

There is no point in saving a few bucks when you cannot guarantee that this savings is going to help you for a long time.

All the above factors are must when you are buying an air conditioner whether it is split air conditioner, window air conditioner, stand-alone air conditioner or a central air conditioner.

You will be able to get a good home air conditioner, in fact, the one that is worth every penny that you are spending on the air conditioner. So, choose wisely and be careful.

Installation Process Of A Window Air Conditioner:

It is not going to be tough at all to install a window air conditioner in your house. You will not need more than an hour for its installation. If you are having professionals for handling the task, then it will be done much faster. The attachment models of each air conditioner would be different and you should be careful about the installation process. Usually, you will have the installation manual along with the air conditioner and you can refer that to get some help regarding the installation process. You will have to measure the window size and unit size. If the window size is large or the unit is not installed in the right way, then the unit is going to fall down. You need to be careful with the measurements.

Here are the steps involved in the installation of a window air conditioner:

1) Open The Bottom Sash You will have to make sure that you have completely opened the bottom sash of the window. If the window is having any screen, then that screen also has to be removed. Once the sash is opened and the window screen is removed, you will have to clean the area with a vacuum. Cleaning is very important for the maintenance of the window air conditioner. 2) Extension Preparation Has To Be Done When you are buying an air conditioner, then you will notice that most of the window air conditioners will come with sliding. This sliding will completely open up so that the window is filled up. A few models of the air conditioner which have they attached and for a few other models, you will have to slide them to the conditioner channel. Make sure that the air conditioner is prepared with all this stuff before it is actually placed in the air conditioner fitting area. 3) Mounting Brackets To Be Prepared You will be able to find two kinds of window air conditioners in the market. One of the air conditioners is the unit will be placed on the sill of the window. But there are other types of a window air conditioner as well and that will have the mounting brackets for placing the air conditioner. You will have to make sure that you are installing the brackets in the right way. The entire process is present in the instructions manual given by the manufacturer. 4) Place The Air Conditioner Unit Properly Now comes the most important step of air conditioner installation and that is placing your air conditioner in its place. You will need the help of another person for placing the window air conditioning unit in its place. You will have to do this placing process from inside and not outside. Also, You will have to lift it with a lot of care and make sure that the unit is sitting exactly on the sill of the window. If the unit is having mounting brackets, then you will have to place the unit in the brackets that are prepared already. Make sure that the brackets get locked after you are placing the air conditioning unit in place. Hold the air conditioner for some time and check it well with the help of your helper. Be sure about the placement of the air conditioner before you leave it. If there is any draining tube to the air conditioning unit, then you should make sure at this point in time only that you are placing it outside. 5) Place The Window Sash Properly You should now lower the upper sash of the window so that it sits flat on the top of the unit, be very careful while you are doing this. Make sure that the upper sash is parallel with the lower sash of the window. Make sure that there are no gaps in the air conditioning unit. 6) Inner Perimeter Should Be Sealed In order to avoid any kind of air to pass in and out of the room, you will have to make sure that you are sealing the inner perimeter with a lot of care. Use the foam for sealing it and then that is going to help in retaining the right temperature inside the room in which an air conditioner is installed. 7) Plug In The Window Air Conditioner You are now done with the installation of the air conditioning unit and it is time to plug and enjoy the cool temperature in your house. Now, check the unit and make sure that everything on the unit is working well and you are able to enjoy a cool temperature in the room. So, the installation is not going to take much time of yours, but you will need the professionals for doing this task. It is the professionals who will be able to do it in the right way and hence you will also be able to enjoy the comfort of an air conditioner. Sometimes, when you are installing a window air conditioner, then you will not be able to use the window at all. If you think that it is sealing you from using the window, then you can install the air conditioner when not in use. That means, in the winter and rainy season you can remove the air and store it in the right way. Now you will be able to use the window as well.

Installation Process Of A Split Air Conditioner

As you are now done with the installation process of the window air conditioner. It is now time to have a look at the installation process of a split air conditioner. The process of installing a split air conditioner is also very simple, just like the window air conditioner. In fact, you will be able to install the split air conditioner much faster than the window unit.

Here is the stepwise procedure for the installation of the split air conditioner:

1) Wall Bracket Installation

In order to mount the split air conditioner to the wall, you will need the bracket that is provided by the manufacturer.

You will have to make holes in the wall according to the requirement.

The bracket is usually of aluminium. The indoor unit will be fixed to this bracket.

Mark the whole points with a lot of care and then you will have to drill with a lot more care.

You will have to fix the bracket on the wall with the help of the screws provided by the manufacturer.

2) Make One Large Hole In The Wall

After you have made the required holes for fixing the bracket on the wall, now it is time to make a large hole on the same wall.

Make the hole large enough to pass the copper pipes through it, which is usually called as the refrigerant tube.

Along with that, you will also have to pass the electric cable which will be connecting the outdoor unit to the indoor unit and the drain hose as well.

3) Install The Indoor Unit Inside

You should now start the installation of the indoor unit in the room in which you want to get the air conditioner fixed.

Place the indoor unit very carefully on the bracket that is provided for the indoor unit installation.

Parallelly pass the electric cable and the water drain hose through the hole which is already made.

You will have to leave the drainage hose free for the water to drain out when the air conditioner is running.

4) Install The Outdoor Unit Outside

The next step of the split air conditioner installation is installing the outdoor unit.

The outdoor unit is usually heavy and hence you should make sure that you are lifting it with a lot of care.

It would be good if you are taking the help of another person for lifting the outdoor unit.

You can install the outdoor unit outside the room in which the indoor unit installed.

It will be easy for connecting the electric wire between them.

Place it on a wall outside the room and make sure that the wall on which you are placing the indoor unit is strong enough that it can hold the weight of the outdoor unit.

5) Install The Copper Pipes

The next step is to connect the copper pipes between the indoor unit and the outdoor unit.

6) Install The Electric Connections

The next and the final step would be to connect the indoor unit and the outdoor unit with the electrical connections.

7) Check The Air Conditioner

The final check has to be done once the air conditioner is installed.

Once the indoor unit and the outdoor units are fitted, then you will have to make sure that the electrical connection is also given.

You can now switch it on and check if the air conditioner is working or not.

Switch it off once and then again switch it on and then check it to make sure that it is working properly.

With this, you are done with the installation of the split air conditioner as well. You will be able to enjoy the room at the temperature of your choice.

Find The Right Professional For Installation

Usually, when you buy an air conditioner, whether it is a window air conditioner or a split air conditioner, you will be able to get the services from the company. They are going to deliver the unit home and they are going to take care of the complete installation process of your air conditioner. You need not to have to worry about how to find one for your installation. But if you want to get it installed by a person you trust or you are buying a second-hand air conditioner, then you will need to find one professional yourself. The task will not be done by the company professionals from where you bought the air conditioner. So, look for an expert who is providing this kind of services for years.

Advantages Of Professional Installation

It is always advised that you should always go for professional help when you are getting your air conditioner installed. That is the best advice that you can get regarding the air conditioner installation because you will have so many benefits to enjoy when you are getting it done with the help of a professional.

Here is the list of the benefits and advantages that you will be able to enjoy with professional Air Conditioner Installations:

1) Measuring And Sizing

It is very important that the measurements and sizes are taken care when you are getting an air conditioner installed.

When the size is correct, then you will be able to enjoy the right temperature in your room is that air conditioner may not be the right one for your room.

The measurements are also very important when you are getting a window air conditioner installed in your house. Buying the wrong size can be a total waste of money.

2) Longevity

When you are doing the installation process yourself, then you may not be sure whether you have done it in the right way or not.

But with professionals, you can be sure that the installation has been done in the right way and it is going to last for a long time.

3) Guarantee

You will have a guarantee of the work done by the professionals.

In case if something goes wrong, then they are going to take care of it.

You don’t have to spend on it to get fixed when something has gone wrong.

Always get that guarantee when you are hiring the professionals and they give you that guarantee because they are confident about their own work.

4) All Specifications Followed

Professionals always take care of details and handle all the specification very precisely.

You may read the installation manual before installing the air conditioner.

But there is no guarantee that you are not going to miss at any point.

These professionals are having years of experience in handling this kind of air conditioner installations.

Hence they are sure that they will handle them in the right way even if they are missing anything.

5) Safety Advice

After the completion of the installation process, you will be able to receive some safety instructions from the experts.

Hence you will be able to maintain your conditioner in the right way.

So, you should make sure that the air conditioner installation is done by the professionals only.

You should be choosing the installation company with a lot of care because you are going to spend a lot on the air conditioner and also on the installation as well. When you are choosing the wrong company, then that can become a disaster and you will not be able to handle it in the right way. You will have to waste your money. You should also keep in mind that you are choosing a company which is providing complete air conditioner installation and other services as well as maintenance, repair, and spares, etc.
